messages:
Evelyn (Finance): Follow-up from today's AH on runway & procurement. Posting a short Q&A thread for anything we missed. Drop questions and I'll answer.
Rashid (Product): Which runway number should product teams use when scoping new pilots?
Evelyn (Finance): Use the conservative planning runway of 10 months for proposals. If your pilot is revenue-facing and expected to close within 90 days, mark as 'revenue experiment' for faster review.
Cara (Eng): If infra needs to prepay a 3-month Dedicated block to lock pricing, how does that affect team caps vs company runway?
Evelyn (Finance): Cash hit reduces company runway immediately. For team dashboards we will amortize the cost across the prepaid months so monthly team burn looks smoother. We'll post an example spreadsheet.
June (FP&A): Action: I'll upload the amortization sample and two scenario sheets (base + downside) to #all-hands-followups by EOD.
Lina (Procurement): Note: prepayments > $75k require Procurement + Finance signoff and supplier-risk attestation. Use the vendor portal fast-track if time-sensitive.
Rashid (Product): Can small Optimize experiments (e.g., 5% traffic to quantized models) proceed without prior finance approval?
Evelyn (Finance): Low-risk pilots (<$2k/mo infra delta and <1% expected quality impact) may run with post-hoc reporting. Otherwise, post a 2-line cost/quality note in #eng-runtime and cc finance.
Cara (Eng): Emergency infra spike during a launch: fastest approval path?
Evelyn (Finance): EMERGENCY in #spend-approvals + ping finance on-call. Finance can approve up to $25k temporary allowance with a 48-hour mitigation plan; >$25k escalates to VP.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: hiring pause guidelines posted in #people-ops. Exceptions need VP approval.
Sam (CEO): Two asks: 1) keep revenue tests unblocked, 2) managers get a one-pager on the approval ladder. Evelyn/June please publish both tomorrow.
Evelyn (Finance): Will post a one-pager and the amortization example in #all-hands-followups by 10am PST and pin it.
June (FP&A): Also offering 30-min office hours Friday for any team-level questions  book via FP&A calendar.
Rashid (Product): Thanks, that helps.
Cara (Eng): Appreciated.
Evelyn (Finance): Thanks all  keep questions here and we'll update the doc as needed.
